name: zeffect_handle_surface_ref_event
description: zEffect::HandleSurfaceRefEvent resolves a child animation for a surface reference, activates the appropriate child runtime command, advances the surface state, and caches the child entry.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect animation event source-cluster pass.
